name: What types of materials are available for sliding door screen replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are available for sliding door screen replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for sliding door screen replacement include fiberglass, aluminum, and pet-resistant screens. Fiberglass is a popular, cost-effective option, offering good visibility and durability. Aluminum screens are stronger and more resistant to tearing. Pet-resistant screens are made from thicker vinyl-coated polyester, designed to withstand scratching and chewing from pets. Other options like solar screens can also be considered to reduce heat and glare.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available screen materials include fiberglass for cost-effectiveness, aluminum for durability, and pet-resistant options for homes with animals.
